newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia stocks make slight gains in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonia stocks make slight gains in light trade.

text.p: Trade was light on the Estonian stock exchange on Monday with dealers saying that many investors had already decided where to place their funds.

"The market was very lazy and it seems much of the unattached money investors had late last year has been put where it should go, so there are less funds for investors to play with right now," said one trader.
The Tallinn exchange index was lower by 0.04 percent to 184.78 on turnover of 23.7 million kroons on the official list.
Saving Bank was the most traded and was firmer to finish 0.40 kroons higher at 86.35 with a trade of 6.9 million kroons.
Hansapank saw 6.2 million kroons of its stock changing hands to close at 176.85 kroons, 0.90 kroons down, while Forekspank was up 0.70 kroons to 146.70 after trading 3.3 million kroons.
Elsewhere on the market, Union Bank turned over 3.0 million kroons to end 0.50 kroons lower at 40.00 kroons.
On the-over-the-counter market trade was quiet with turnover of only 5.0 million kroons.
Rakvere meat plant was the dominant trade with 3.0 million kroons changing hands to close lower at 15.50, down 0.15 kroons.
Norma plastic manufacturer also dipped to close down 0.15 kroons with a light trade of 0.97 million kroons.
